description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuItemAPI class in the OrangeHRM Mobile API module. It tests different scenarios for the getOne API method, including cases when leave and timesheet periods are defined or not, and when the time module is disabled. Additionally, it tests that update, delete, and their validation rules are not implemented.

classes.name: MenuItemAPITest
classes.description: A test class for testing the MenuItemAPI endpoints, especially the getOne method under different configurations, and ensuring that other methods are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of MenuItemAPI with leave and timesheet periods defined.

methods.name: testGetOne2
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of MenuItemAPI when leave and timesheet periods are not defined.

methods.name: testGetOne3
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of MenuItemAPI when the Time module is disabled.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the update method of MenuItemAPI is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rules for update are not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method of MenuItemAPI is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rules for delete are not implemented.
